content:
The **Ammo Dump** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

An old waste dump for munitions, this little junkyard was taken over by Raiders in the wake of the 2077-78 winter and turned into a trading outpost.

This area is protected by two Turrets. There is a trailer, with a small garden containing six Wild Corn and three Wild Gourd Blossoms next to it. As an old Raider camp, there are many dead Raiders that can be found in the location, such as a Raider corpse sitting at a picnic table near the entry which may have a Caps Stash. A Power Armor Station is also present.

The Ammo Dump appears in *Fallout 76*.

Dacio Pasarell worked on the location's worldbuilding and layout. [Ext 1]
